title: AdaOS Skill WebUI Manifest (webui.json)
description: Declarative UI contributions for a skill. Merged by WebspaceScenarioRuntime into ui.application / data.catalog / registry.merged.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editors/validators.

resources.description: Skill UI resources resolved by the AdaOS runtime and browser client, not by arbitrary skill-hosted static routes.

llm_hints.description: Builder-readable UI contribution hints for AI-assisted and human authoring workflows.

nlu_hints.description: Builder-readable NLU hints for UI aliases, examples, slot schemas, entities, and owner routing.

voice_capabilities.description: Public user-facing capabilities that may be addressed by voice or typed conversational input.

voice_affordances.description: Voice-addressable UI targets such as modal tabs, sections, filters, buttons, and reachable panels.

interface.description: Skill-owned declarative UI view contract. Views are public domain UI addresses; widgets and modals are renderer surfaces that implement them.

behaviors.description: Deterministic interaction state machines for buttons, tabs, modals, pages, and multi-step flows. These records select existing declarative actions; they do not embed executable code.

ydoc_defaults.description: Default Yjs values applied once per webspace. Keys are 'root/key' paths (e.g. 'data/voice_chat').

contributions.description: Declarative contributions to extension points (e.g. auto-install apps/widgets).

id.description: Identifier; may include ':' for synthetic ids (e.g. 'scenario:<id>').

i18nTextSpec.description: Locale-independent text reference resolved by the browser with the sibling field as fallback.

uiResources.description: Map of stable resource ids to browser-facing static assets. References use resource:<id> tokens from icons, images, inputs, or semantic config.

kind.description: Semantic resource role. The browser decides the concrete renderer/cache behavior.

role.description: Optional use-specific role layered on top of kind, e.g. i18n for localized dictionaries.

locale.description: Optional BCP-47 locale tag for localized data resources.

path.description: Skill-relative or package-relative path. Runtime must normalize and serve it through the core channel.

url.description: Optional browser URL. Core-delivered resources usually receive this during runtime materialization; delivery='external' resources must author a URL that remains in the manifest.

cacheKey.description: Stable cache key such as sha256:<digest>; changes invalidate browser caches.

delivery.description: core means AdaOS publishes the asset into the browser resource store; external keeps the authored URL in the manifest and does not copy bytes into the local blob store.

skillInterface.description: Public domain UI contract for a skill. A view is a stable addressable use-case such as notebook.notes.list or notebook.note.edit.

modalInterface.description: Public address contract for a concrete modal. Routes map address params into private modal/page state.

modalHistoryContract.description: Optional browser URL/history binding for addressed modal routes.

modalDomainContract.description: Declarative modal domain state machine. States are domain/use-case states, routes are concrete modal addresses.

uiOwnershipContract.description: Ownership split for domain truth, route state, view state, and durable persistence confirmation.

state.description: Private modal/page state patch computed after address validation.

loadPhase.description: Coarse-grained load intent for a surface or data branch.

focusPhase.description: Relative focus priority for staged or multi-surface interfaces.

readinessState.description: Expected readiness contract token surfaced while off-focus hydration is still in progress.

loadHint.description: Intent-level staged rendering hints. These are not scheduler commands.

ref.description: Semantic target ref such as widget:search-box or control:city.

required.description: When true, missing focus target is a manifest/design issue instead of a silent no-op.

defaultAction.description: Action id/ref invoked when Enter submits the current form context.
Shortcut for submit.defaultAction on simple widgets/surfaces.

statePath.description: Optional Yjs/view-state path that carries loading/status information.

readyWhen.description: Client expression for considering the element ready.

retainLastValue.description: Keep the last rendered value while a fresh value is loading or stale.

launchAction.description: Compact catalog launch action used by desktop app tiles.

propertyNames.description: Widget properties are nested JSON members; dotted property names are not interpreted as paths.

area.description: Optional default area when pinned as a widget.

modals.description: Modal registry. Can be a map {id: modalDef} or an array of modal ids (legacy).

widgets.description: Widget registry. Can be a map {id: widgetDef} or an array of widget ids (legacy).

implements.description: Domain UI view ids implemented by this modal.

overlay.description: Alias for presentation kept for manifests that model modals as overlays.

overlayPresentation.description: Runtime overlay presentation contract. The renderer owns mechanics such as Ionic modal, sheet, or drawer, while the manifest declares lifecycle intent.

kind.description: Renderer intent hint for the overlay shape.

restoreFocus.description: Shortcut for focus.restoreOrigin. Defaults to true.

overlayFocusPolicy.description: Focus lifecycle policy for runtime-owned overlays. Defaults protect accessibility by releasing hidden background focus and restoring the opener after dismissal.

captureOrigin.description: Capture the active element before opening so it can be restored later.

releaseBackground.description: Blur focused background elements before the renderer hides the background surface.

restoreOrigin.description: Restore focus to the captured origin after the overlay closes, when still connected and visible.

playbackEndpointProvider.description: Skill-owned endpoint inbox adapter used by the persistent app-shell media element while its surface is idle.

initialState.description: Local page/modal state defaults applied only for keys that are not already set.

initialStateSource.description: Reactive, explicitly mapped runtime state source.

initialStateQuery.description: One-shot, explicitly mapped URL query values applied on first paint.

autoActions.description: Lightweight interval actions active only while this page/modal is mounted.

semantic.description: Optional semantic UI layer consumed by the client adapter.

pattern.description: Renderer intent hint. Keeps skill manifests declarative without requiring renderer-specific CSS.

sidebarWidth.description: Preferred desktop sidebar width in CSS pixels. Compact layouts still use the responsive drawer.

auxWidth.description: Preferred desktop auxiliary-panel width in CSS pixels. Medium and compact layouts may stack it.

variants.description: State-selected full-surface layouts. The first matching when expression wins; one optional default variant is the deterministic fallback. Widgets whose areas are absent from the selected variant are outside the active view.

when.description: Safe page-state expression. Variants are tested in declaration order.

default.description: Use this variant when no when expression matches. Authors should declare at most one default.

width.description: Preferred desktop width in CSS pixels for nav/sidebar or auxiliary areas. Responsive layouts may stack or drawer the area.

propertyNames.description: Widget properties are nested JSON members; dotted property names are not interpreted as paths.

name.description: Skill data source target in '<skill>.<method>' form.

cacheTtlMs.description: Runtime read cache lifetime. Zero keeps the semantic read until explicit invalidation.

invalidationTags.description: Addressable tags that can invalidate this runtime read.

preserveLastValue.description: Keep the last successful value visible while a matching invalidation is revalidated.

maxRequestHz.description: Maximum request start rate for one semantic runtime-read identity.

resource.description: Resource id from top-level resources when kind='resource'.

nodeId.description: Optional node id or state template for node-scoped stream/Yjs sources.

observeRoot.description: For Yjs data sources, observe the root data map and read the declared path from it. Use when a skill replaces a plain JSON subtree.

observe.description: Observation strategy for Yjs data sources. dataRoot is equivalent to observeRoot=true.

scope.description: Addressing intent for node-aware modal opens. Shared streams and shared Yjs branches are not node-scoped.

transport.description: Preferred stream transport. Receiver-level transport is used when omitted or set to auto.

intervalMs.description: Requested interval. The client clamps very small values to a safe minimum.

enabledIf.description: Client state expression evaluated before each tick.

once.description: Run immediately once when the surface mounts instead of installing a repeating timer.

timeoutMs.description: Fallback timeout when observe.timeoutMs is omitted.

timeout.description: Fallback state/message when observation does not complete.

disable.description: Disable the triggering control while the action is awaiting feedback.

icon.description: Ionicon name or resource:<id> for the pending state.

path.description: Yjs path for kind='y' or JSON pointer/dot path into the stream value for kind='stream'.

key.description: Expected item key for kind='stream' when path selects a collection. Supports runtime tokens such as $event.name.

idField.description: Item field used with key for kind='stream'. Defaults to name.

id_field.description: Legacy spelling accepted for existing _observe-style manifests.

mode.description: Observation mode hint. Patch waits for a structural stream patch or the resulting collection value.

timeout_ms.description: Legacy spelling accepted for existing _observe-style manifests.

fieldPath.description: Dot-separated path read from the current widget payload or page state.

outlineInputs.description: Generic navigation outline. Data may be nested through childrenKey or flat through parentIdKey; typed target objects remain opaque to the renderer and are exposed to declarative actions.

listInputs.description: Inputs for ui.list in rows, grouped rows, or responsive card mode.

sort.description: Optional stable list sorting. Use key/direction directly or select an entry in options through stateKey/value.

title.description: Concise native tooltip and accessible name for the command. Falls back to description, label, then id.

description.description: Longer explanation of the command, suitable for a tooltip fallback and channel-neutral help.

guidanceActionId.description: Semantic next-action id implemented by this control when its visual id serves another purpose such as view selection or row-action variants.

kind.description: Semantic button intent. Use danger for destructive or irreversible commands; presentation remains theme-controlled.

fill.description: Optional presentation emphasis. Prefer kind over raw colors.

selectedStateKey.description: Page-state key containing the selected option value for a menu-style action.

options.description: Static options for a menu-style action. Dynamic options may be supplied by optionsDataSource.

optionsDataSource.description: Runtime data source used to populate a menu-style action without materializing options in the page descriptor.

persistFallback.description: Persist the first available option when the selected state is absent or no longer valid.

refreshOptionsOnOpen.description: Refresh dynamic options when a menu opens. Dynamic option sources refresh on open by default.

chatInputs.description: Inputs for ui.chat. Multiline composers use Shift+Enter for a newline and Enter or Ctrl/Cmd+Enter for submit by default.

formInputs.description: Inputs for ui.form. This is the compatibility container for typed Google-Forms-like field declarations.

questions.description: Alias for fields used by survey/prototyping authoring tools.

secondaryActions.description: Optional presentation metadata for non-primary form actions. Each id must match a supported trigger declared in widget.actions, such as cancel.

layout.description: Field layout. responsiveGrid packs fields into an adaptive grid and collapses to one column when space is narrow.

formFieldType.description: Deprecated alias for formInputType. ui.form.inputs.fields[*].type remains the runtime property.

visibleIf.description: State expression controlling visibility. Supports canonical $state comparisons/logical operators and literal true/false.

span.description: Column span used only by responsiveGrid forms. Use full for long text, uploads, and section-wide controls.

serviceFrameInputs.description: Inputs for a governed AdaOS service UI. The browser client derives the authenticated same-origin bootstrap URL; arbitrary iframe URLs are not accepted.

frameViewerInputs.description: Inputs for visual.frameViewer. Payloads may provide image.media as a browser-routed media descriptor or image.src/src/url/base64 for local previews.

imageField.description: Payload path for a direct image URL/data URL. Defaults to image.src.

fullscreenMediaField.description: Payload path for the high-quality fullscreen media descriptor. Defaults include image.fullscreen_media.

prefetchMediaField.description: Payload path for the next media descriptor to prefetch while fullscreen is open. Defaults include image.next_media.

aspectRatio.description: CSS aspect-ratio token for the inline frame stage, e.g. '16 / 9'.

fullscreenOnClick.description: Open the frame viewer fullscreen surface when the image is clicked/tapped.

nativeFullscreen.description: Request browser native fullscreen after opening the runtime fullscreen surface.

retainLastImageOnEmpty.description: Keep the last loaded image when a stream update omits image data.

icon.description: Ionicon token. The client provides compact glyph fallbacks when icons are unavailable.

labelField.description: Payload path that overrides label at render time.

iconField.description: Payload path that overrides icon at render time.

idField.description: Payload path that overrides action id at render time.

local.description: Client-local frame action. Currently supported: closeFullscreen.

keyActionMap.description: Map from KeyboardEvent.key to a widget action id.

mediaDescriptor.description: Browser-facing media reference carried in stream payloads, commonly at image.media. WebUI streams should prefer this over inline base64 for large media.

route.description: Runtime route the browser should use to resolve the media object.

receivers.description: Transport-independent browser stream receivers resolved by runtime and exposed to widgets via dataSource.kind='stream'.

mode.description: How incoming stream payloads update local client state.

collectionKey.description: For append mode, the array field that accumulates incoming items.

dedupeBy.description: Optional item field used to replace an existing item instead of appending a duplicate.

idField.description: Collection item identity field used by structural stream patches. Defaults to dedupeBy or name.

itemPath.description: Collection path updated by structural stream patches. JSON pointer paths such as /items are supported.

patches.description: Whether the receiver may publish adaos.stream.patch.v1 envelopes in addition to full snapshots.

maxItems.description: Optional local ring-buffer limit for append mode.

initialState.description: Optional initial client-side receiver state before the first stream event arrives.

transport.description: Default transport for widgets observing this receiver.

snapshotPolicy.description: How the receiver recovers initial state after subscribe/resubscribe.

ttlMs.description: Freshness TTL for replace-mode stream variables.

sequenceField.description: Field used to reject stale or duplicate stream payloads.

updatedAtField.description: Field carrying the producer timestamp for freshness checks.

budget.description: Declared receiver budget used by review, diagnostics, and future stream guards.

guardVisibility.description: Operator-visible degraded/quarantine behavior when receiver budgets are exceeded.

route.description: Reviewable data-route metadata for this receiver.

on.description: Trigger name, for example select, click:<buttonId>, or change:<fieldId>. On command bars/actions, click with no id applies to every button; click with action.id targets that button.

id.description: Stable action id used by defaultAction, submit, keyboard, and feedback contracts. With on=click in command bars/actions, also binds the action to the button with the same id.

type.description: Runtime action type (e.g. 'callHost'). Legacy type 'none' is accepted as a compatibility no-op, but generators should remove obsolete action entries instead of emitting it.

invalidates.description: Addressable runtime data-source tags invalidated after a successful callSkill mutation.

openResultUrl.description: For callSkill actions, open a URL returned by the successful skill result.

resultUrlPath.description: Result path used as the URL source when openResultUrl is enabled.

resultUrlTarget.description: Browser window target for the URL opened from a skill result.

resultPreferCurrentOrigin.description: Rebase app-navigation URLs returned by a skill result to the current browser app origin.

allowOffline.description: Allow this action to run when the target or client transport is offline. Remote actions are blocked by default; local UI actions are unaffected.

enabledIf.description: Optional canonical page-state condition. A false condition skips the action without side effects.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL or browser-safe relative URL. /api URLs are resolved against the AdaOS API base.

download.description: Append download=1 for API-backed file links when not already present.

withAuth.description: Attach the current AdaOS token to same-backend /api URLs.
